light.method: 内置 image_gen AI 绘画
light.prompt: Original premium art for a desktop theme, landscape16:9 target3840x2160. Pure artwork, no letters, text, logos, watermark, UI or picture frames. Asymmetrical exquisite composition, left half gentle quiet low-detail negative space, main visual to the right. Ink Landscape LIGHT. ORIGINAL contemporary Chinese ink wash landscape painting on delicate ivory xuan paper: expressive grey-black mountain cliffs and a few dark pine silhouettes on far RIGHT, layered pale misty ridgelines fading to a nearly empty ivory LEFT half, tiny single vermilion-red boat near lower right for exquisite scale. Beautiful controlled ink gradation, fine dry-brush rock edges, tactile but quiet paper, elegant literati composition without copying any painting. Absolutely NO calligraphy, seals, characters or stamps.
